description: This file contains utility functions and components related to Mermaid diagram conversion, rendering, and storage within the Excalidraw project. It includes functions for resetting previews, converting Mermaid definitions to Excalidraw elements, saving data to local storage, and inserting elements into the editor.

methods.name: resetPreview
methods.description: Resets the preview canvas by clearing its background and children, and resetting error state.

methods.name: convertMermaidToExcalidraw
methods.description: Converts a Mermaid diagram definition into Excalidraw elements, renders it on a canvas, and handles errors.

methods.name: saveMermaidDataToStorage
methods.description: Saves the Mermaid diagram definition string to local storage.

methods.name: insertToEditor
methods.description: Inserts Excalidraw elements into the editor and optionally saves Mermaid data to storage.
